# MobileFuse

> MobileFuse specializes in advanced in-app and CTV brand advertising, offering targeted solutions using proprietary technologies to enhance audience engagement and maximize advertising performance.

## About MobileFuse
- [In-App Advertising Solutions](https://mobilefuse.com): Showcase MobileFuse's in-app advertising solutions and target audience strategies for brands and advertisers.
- [About MobileFuse](https://mobilefuse.com/about-us): Learn about MobileFuse's history, culture, and expertise in mobile advertising.
- [Contact MobileFuse](https://mobilefuse.com/contact): Facilitate communication with MobileFuse via a contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mobilefuse.com/privacy-policy): Details on MobileFuse's data collection and usage practices.
- [Cookies Policy](https://mobilefuse.com/cookies-policy): Explains cookie usage for enhancing user experience.
- [Careers Overview](https://mobilefuse.com/careers): To recruit potential employees by highlighting company culture, values, and job opportunities at MobileFuse.
- [MobileFuse Supply Partner Hub](https://docs.mobilefuse.com/): The MobileFuse supply partner hub provides all of our documentation for publishers to monetize with MobileFuse.

## Solutions and Services
- [Targeted Advertising Solutions](https://mobilefuse.com/mfx): Customizable programmatic advertising marketplace for video and display inventory.
- [Mindset Targeting Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/mindset-targeting-insights): Advanced targeting techniques for effective audience engagement.
- [Creative Advertising Showcase](https://mobilefuse.com/creative): Explore advertising creative options for digital campaigns across verticals.
- [In-App Brand Advertising](https://mobilefuse.com/): Comprehensive solutions for in-app and CTV environments.
- [Publisher Partnerships Overview](https://mobilefuse.com/publishers): Offer premium advertising partnerships and tools for publishers to maximize revenue and ease of integration.

## Case Studies
- [Advertising Case Studies](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies): Showcase case studies demonstrating MobileFuse's advertising effectiveness across various industries.
- [Retail Campaign Success](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/retail): Highlights successful retail advertising campaigns.
- [Auto Marketing Campaign](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/auto): Case study on targeting Hispanic shoppers for an auto brand.
- [Shopper Marketing Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/shopper-marketing): Performance insights from shopper marketing campaigns.
- [QSR Campaign Success](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/qsr): Fast-food campaign that increased foot traffic through targeted advertising.
- [Valentine's Day Campaign](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/cpg): Case study on an ice cream brand's Valentine's Day campaign.
- [Travel Campaign Success](https://mobilefuse.com/case-studies/travel): Case studies showcasing marketing success in the travel sector.

## Creative Showcase
- [Creative Advertising Showcase](https://mobilefuse.com/creative): Explore advertising creative options for digital campaigns across verticals.
- [CTV Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=ctv): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Connected TV (CTV) ad format.
- [DOOH Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=dooh): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Digital Out of Home (DOOH) ad format.
- [Rich Media Interstitial Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=rich_media_interstitial): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Rich Media Interstitial ad format.
- [Rich Media Expandable Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=rich_media_expandable): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Rich Media Expandable ad format.
- [Rich Media Banner Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=rich_media_banner): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Rich Media Banner ad format.
- [Flex Interstitial Creatives](https://mobilefuse.com/creative?ad_type=flex_interstitial): Showcase various advertising creatives for the Flex Interstitial ad format.

## News
- [MobileFuse News Updates](https://mobilefuse.com/news): To share news and updates related to MobileFuse's advertising and technology advancements.

- [2024 Marketing Trends](https://mobilefuse.com/news/embrace-the-freedom-to-innovate-2024-digital-marketing-trends): Highlighting innovative trends in digital marketing for 2024 to guide brands in adapting their strategies.
- [Understanding Alt IDs in Advertising](https://mobilefuse.com/news/alt-ids-an-improvement-or-replacement): Discusses the importance and implications of Alt IDs in advertising as third-party cookies are phased out.
- [In-App Advertising Shift](https://mobilefuse.com/news/the-fall-of-web-advertising-and-the-rise-of-in-app): Discusses the shift from web advertising to in-app mobile advertising amidst industry challenges.
- [Sustainability Commitment](https://mobilefuse.com/news/adnetzero-founding-supporter): Highlighting MobileFuse's commitment to sustainability and support for Ad Net Zero's initiatives in advertising.
- [MobileFuse Trust Index Ranking](https://mobilefuse.com/news/mobilefuse-maintains-number-one-position-on-pixalate-seller-trust-index-for-four-consecutive-quarters): Highlight MobileFuse's achievement as the top-ranked seller on the Pixalate Seller Trust Index for Q3 2023.
- [Digital Advertising Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/brace-for-impact-tiktoks-potential-departure-fuels-antitrust-debate-shakes-up-digital-advertising): Discusses TikTok's impact on digital advertising and the implications for brands amidst potential regulatory changes.
- [Mother's Day Marketing Tips](https://mobilefuse.com/news/digital-marketing-strategies-for-mothers-day): Guide brands on effective digital marketing strategies for Mother's Day to enhance customer engagement and sales.
- [Optimizing Advertising with Data](https://mobilefuse.com/news/thankful-for-successful-ad-creatives-how-to-utilize-data-analytics-to-optimize-consumer-engagement): To educate brands on using data analytics for optimizing advertising strategies and enhancing consumer engagement.
- [Ad Budget and Bidding Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/53-adtech-101-balancing-budgets-and-bids-for-maximum-roi): To educate advertisers on optimizing ad budgets and bidding strategies for better ROI in digital marketing.
- [Thanksgiving AdTech Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/54-thanksgiving-in-the-digital-age-how-adtech-helps-you-serve-the-right-message): Discusses how AdTech personalizes advertising for Thanksgiving, enhancing brand messaging and audience targeting.
- [Digital Advertising Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/adtech-101-mastering-digital-advertising-platforms-for-brand-growth): Educating brands on digital advertising platforms for growth and optimized marketing strategies.
- [Effective Ad Design Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/46-adtech-101-creating-ads-that-work): To educate brands on effective ad design strategies for creating impactful advertising.
- [Employee Retention Success](https://mobilefuse.com/news/how-mobilefuse-achieves-longevity-20-percent-employees-decade-service): Showcasing MobileFuse's employee retention success and positive workplace culture.
- [Keyword Research for SEO](https://mobilefuse.com/news/adtech-101-optimizing-keyword-research-for-seo-success): Educating readers on effective keyword research techniques to improve SEO performance.
- [Valentine's Marketing Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/digital-marketing-bliss-matchmaking-brands-with-customers-despite-targeting-hardship): Offer strategies for brands to engage consumers effectively during Valentine's Day amidst targeting challenges.
- [Optimize Your Digital Ads](https://mobilefuse.com/news/spring-cleaning-your-digital-ads-tips-for-a-blossoming-campaign): To offer tips for optimizing digital advertising campaigns for better engagement and performance.
- [Generative AI Ad Guide](https://mobilefuse.com/news/produce-amazing-ad-creatives-utilizing-generative-ai): Guide for creating ad creatives using generative AI tools like Midjourney.
- [Avoiding Ad Fatigue](https://mobilefuse.com/news/49-spooky-season-avoiding-ad-fatigue-in-october): To provide strategies for marketers to prevent ad fatigue during the Halloween season.
- [Father's Day Marketing Tips](https://mobilefuse.com/news/winning-digital-marketing-strategies-for-fathers-day): To provide effective digital marketing strategies for brands to engage customers during Father's Day.
- [Understanding Alternative IDs](https://mobilefuse.com/news/alternative-ids-101-an-overview): Explains the role and benefits of alternative IDs in digital advertising amid changing privacy regulations.
- [Summer Advertising Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/summer-vibes): To provide strategies for effective mobile advertising campaigns during the summer season.
- [2024 Election and Ad Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/2024-election-to-impact-all--digital-ad-buying): Discuss the impact of the 2024 election on digital advertising strategies and challenges.
- [Holiday Advertising Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/haunted-by-low-conversions-discover-the-secrets-to-better-holidays-results): This webpage offers strategies for improving advertising campaigns during the holiday season to increase conversions and sales.
- [Enhancing Retail Media Strategies](https://mobilefuse.com/news/maximizing-retail-media-with-first-party-data): Discusses utilizing first-party data to enhance retail media strategies and drive growth amid digital advertising challenges.
- [Indie Giving Impact](https://mobilefuse.com/news/giving-thanks-for-indie-giving): Highlighting the impact of Indie Giving and its partnership with GDC in supporting local charities in San Francisco.
- [Advertising Emissions Guide](https://mobilefuse.com/news/navigating-the-advertising-industrys-emissions-a-guide-for-brands): Guide brands on navigating emissions in the advertising industry and promoting sustainability efforts.
- [Ad Copywriting Tips](https://mobilefuse.com/news/45-adtech-101-writing-attention-grabbing-ad-copy): To provide guidance on writing effective ad copy that captures attention and drives action.
- [In-App Advertising Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/in-app-vs-mobile-web-ad-spend-conundrum): Discusses the disparity in ad spending between mobile apps and the mobile web, highlighting in-app advertising advantages.
- [Defining Ideal Audience](https://mobilefuse.com/news/adtech-101-defining-and-reaching-your-ideal-audience): Guide advertisers on defining and reaching their ideal audience using advanced AdTech strategies.
- [2024 Adtech Resolutions](https://mobilefuse.com/news/2024-adtech-resolutions-steering-through-industry-shifts-and-finding-new-audiences): Discuss strategies for advertisers to adapt to upcoming shifts in the digital advertising industry in 2024.
- [Apple's Privacy Manifest Explained](https://mobilefuse.com/news/apples-privacy-manifest-a-new-era-in-data-privacy): Discusses Apple's Privacy Manifest and its implications for data privacy and app transparency.
- [Campaign Optimization Insights](https://mobilefuse.com/news/55-adtech-101-optimizing-campaigns-for-better-ad-performance): Educating advertisers on optimizing campaign performance through structured analysis and adjustments.
- [AdTech Privacy Guidance](https://mobilefuse.com/news/privacy-questions-brands-and-advertisers-need-to-ask-adtech-partners): Guide brands and advertisers on essential privacy questions for adtech partnerships.
- [MobileFuse Ranking Announcement](https://mobilefuse.com/news/mobilefuse-pixalate-number-one-rank): Announcing MobileFuse's top ranking in the Pixalate Seller Trust Index for mobile advertising platforms.
- [Google's Web Impact Analysis](https://mobilefuse.com/news/google-is-destroying-the-web-it-built): Analyzing Google's impact on web traffic and the need for advertisers to adapt their strategies.

### Partnerships and Industry Leadership
- [Adelaide Partnership Announcement](https://mobilefuse.com/news/mobilefuse-partners-with-adelaide-on-comprehensive-network-audit-offers-high-au-mobile-and-ctv-marketplace-to-customers): Announcing partnership with Adelaide to enhance media quality and performance for advertisers in mobile and CTV markets.
- [MobileFuse and LiveRamp Partnership](https://mobilefuse.com/news/mobilefuse-expands-partnership-with-liveramp-increases-publisher-fill-rates-over-300): Announcing the partnership between MobileFuse and LiveRamp to enhance publisher monetization and fill rates through privacy-centric solutions.
- [Criteo Partnership Announcement](https://mobilefuse.com/news/51-mobilefuse-bolsters-retail-media-capabilities-with-criteo-commerce-audiences): Announcing MobileFuse's partnership with Criteo to enhance retail media capabilities through improved audience targeting.
- [MobileFuse and ID5 Partnership](https://mobilefuse.com/news/56-mobilefuse-announces-partnership-with-id5-enhances-campaign-performance-and-roi): Announces MobileFuse's partnership with ID5 to enhance advertising campaign performance and address privacy concerns.
- [MobileFuse and iSpot.tv Partnership](https://mobilefuse.com/news/mobilefuse-partners-with-ispot-tv-bolsters-ctv-and-video-measurement-capabilities): Announcing MobileFuse's partnership with iSpot.tv to enhance advertising measurement capabilities for connected TV.

Crafted for Quality. Engineered for Results.

With 15 years of expertise, MobileFuse is your trusted partner for targeted brand campaigns, running cross-screen with Video, Display, and Rich Media formats.

Proof in Performance

Visitation

Our campaigns don't just engage, they mobilize. 91% of measured campaigns show a lift in incremental visits, including visits from new customers and increased visits from existing customers.

Sales Lift

Online or in-store, we turn exposure into action. Our campaigns seamlessly drive shoppers to shop now, driving an average sales lift of 23%.

Brand Lift

We go deeper than surface-level metrics. MobileFuse quantifies brand performance across the entire funnel, from awareness and ad recall to consideration, favorability, and intent. Among campaigns with awareness KPIs, MobileFuse drives an average lift of 12%.

Incremental Reach

Reach untapped audiences on CTV. By bridging linear and digital measurement, our cross-screen campaigns deliver verified incremental reach with a highly successful average incremental reach of 86%.

eCommerce

Our outcome-based media solutions are built to move users from interest to action.
